messages:
marina: Heads-up: planned maintenance WINDOW 2025-11-12 22:00-00:30 UTC for pool 'saturn' (apac-west1 shards). We'll apply a kernel hotpatch and perform controlled soft reboots of GPUs. Cohorts of 15 nodes every 8m. Expect up to ~18% temporary GPU capacity reduction while cohorts move. Backfill from gradient-pool; spot-burst allowed as last resort. No full-region failover planned.

ashok: Oncall for this window. I'll run preflight checks 45m prior and monitor SLOs. Pause rotation if p95 > 220ms or error rate >3%. I'll post live metrics to #eng-infra during the run.

kyle: Network note: last hotpatch we saw 4-6s TCP stalls during driver handshake in apac-west1. Recommend NIC firmware counters + tcpdump sampling on 1st cohort and an egress stress 90m before.

marina: Agreed. Add netdiag step: ops/net-check --pool saturn --sample 120s and schedule a short tcpdump (8s) 3min into cohort #1.

sre-bot: [automation] maintenance scheduled by marina window=2025-11-12T22:00:00Z/2025-11-13T00:30:00Z pools=[saturn] cohort_size=15 interval_m=8 tags=[maintenance-2025-11-12-hotpatch]

lucy: Comms: I'll draft the status page blurb and flag dedicated/reserved tenants. Posting to #support-alerts 60m before and DMs to top 12 reservations. Message will include expected capacity dip and contact for escalations. :mega:

jamie: Product joins: please freeze heavy embedding/batch jobs that could spike during the window (22:00-00:30). I'll add a calendar hold for infra-impacting jobs.

sre-lead: Cost IOFYI: backfill + possible cross-region egress worst-case ~4k USD. Ensure all temporary instances are tagged maintenance-2025-11-12-hotpatch for finance reconciliation.

ashok: Runbook snippet for leads (copy/paste):
```bash
# preflight (~45m before)
ops/check-pool-health --pool=saturn --p95=220ms --err=3% --nodes=summary
# run egress stress test
ops/egress-stress --pool=saturn --duration=120 --target=10rps
# drain cohort
ops/drain-cohort --pool=saturn --count=15 --mode=soft --wait=480
# backfill if needed
ops/backfill --from=gradient-pool --to=saturn --count=15 --policy=spot-burst-allowed --tag=maintenance-2025-11-12-hotpatch
# nic check on cohort node
ops/nic-check --node=$NODE --firmware-counters --retransmit-threshold=0.5
```

marina: Rollback criteria: stop all further drains and initiate recovery if sustained p95 > 300ms for 8m, error rate >6% for 3m, or driver/kernel panic signs on backfilled nodes. Recovery actions: rehydrate previously drained nodes, reduce route weights to saturn, and if kernel is culprit, roll back kernel and re-run health checks.

lucy: I've queued the status page draft and tenant DMs. Will include explicit link to incident channel for updates and the estimated capacity delta.

jamie: Also note: we'll hold any PRs that schedule large nightly jobs overlapping 23:30-00:30 UTC. PMs will be notified.

ashok: Primary oncall is me, marina is backup. I'll post a go/no-go at 21:45 UTC and start preflight at 21:15 UTC. Ping @ashok for alerts during the window.

marina: Final: preflight 21:15, go/no-go 21:45, start 22:00. Post-window: KV cache warmup sweep, sanity traffic replay, remove maintenance tags, and cost tag cleanup. Thanks :white_check_mark:
